changesSinceRound2: Paired routing graphics are excluded from semantic labels and retained as decorations; label_mode=literal preserves legacy labels.
Detached ordinary bullet appendices after explicit trees are prose in auto mode; list_policy=include or mode=tree preserves them.
Separated normalization/extraction, list classification, wire cleanup, and iterative forest construction.
evaluationPolicy: Freeze fixed parser before generation. Independent source-first subagent audits all labels, roots, edges, prose/continuations and line accounting. Clean semantic labels are primary. Standalone bullet trees and explicit ASCII appendix branches are trees; detached ordinary prose lists after an explicit tree are excluded by automatic extraction, with any intrinsically ambiguous intent reported separately. Record first-run failures before further parser changes.
